canonicalization.justification: the two run roots differ by construction; canonicalizing them keeps embedded provenance paths MUST_MATCH instead of being ignored
canonicalization.rule: each run root's own absolute path is replaced by the literal token <RUN_ROOT> in all text, JSON string, and YAML string content before comparison

comparison_principles.array_exactness: dtype AND shape AND exact C-order bytes; NaN representation and NaN position are therefore compared bit-exactly
comparison_principles.blindness: reports contain logical names, classes, match status, and digests only; no scientific value is ever emitted
comparison_principles.float_exactness: scalar floats compared as IEEE-754 little-endian bit patterns; NaN and -0.0 are distinguished
comparison_principles.granularity: semantic dataset/field comparison; whole-file byte equality is never used as the primary predicate except for frozen input copies and opaque image bytes
comparison_principles.inventory_rule: the relative-path inventories of both run roots must be identical; any missing or extra entry is a FAIL
comparison_principles.unclassified_behaviour: any logical name in governed scope belonging to neither MUST_MATCH nor DECLARED_IGNORED is a FAIL

disposition_rule.FAIL: any MUST_MATCH difference, any inventory difference, or any unclassified logical name
disposition_rule.PASS: every MUST_MATCH logical name matched exactly, inventories were identical, and nothing was unclassified

governed_scope.definition: every filesystem entry beneath each of the two run output roots produced by 08_run_r1_full_session_validation.sh

not_ignored_explicitly: provenance, source, model, PCA, config and classifier identities are load-bearing and are MUST_MATCH
absolute paths that are NOT run-root dependent (locked worktree paths, input paths, module files) remain MUST_MATCH
no metadata group is ignored wholesale
